snippet.title: Turbo Dismount 2 - Full Release Trailer!
snippet.description:
*** Out now on Steam! ***
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2280350/Turbo_Dismount_2/

Eight years of development! The sequel to the physics-based comedic racing game Turbo Dismount is finally here!

Here is what we have cooked for you:
* Full manual vehicle controls
* Multiple passengers in vehicles
* Much improved physics
* Powerful Workshop tools
* Upgraded graphics
* Support for animated faces
* Support for live webcam video faces!
* Replay mode with slow-mo and time-reversal, plus video export
* Movie Mode that allows you to create cinematic multi-shot masterpieces!
* Artisanal sound effects
* A great soundtrack
* And more!

Get Turbo Dismount 2 on Steam now!
